notes.title: What I'm working on in 2024
notes.notes:
Hello,
I'm currently hard at work on my next game, working title: [i]Primrose Roads[/i]! It's a mystery game with FMV driving elements, here's a video of the current state. Featuring a fog horn that gets recharged when heading into the wrong lane (where people honk at you), proper connections between FMV hotspots and story events... And lots of fog!

Hello everyone!

- The dog neighbor finally has a talking animation!
- And the sausages don't appear on Bommel Beach anymore! (It's a no sausage beach)

And my third game FUNNY WALK - A GARBAGE VOYAGE is out! Not yet on Steam,
as I am [i]slightly [/i]broke, but it can be downloaded [url=https://gracelessgames.itch.io/funnywalk]here[/url]!

notes.title: Another small update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

this small update contains these changes:
[list][*] The berry chaser sequence at the end a little bit shorter.
[*] I've raised the default multiplier in the Driving School slightly so people less inclined to do "stunts and backflips" won't be stuck there forever.
[*] Ignoring the Deity and skipping school also adds to the rudeness now.
[*] Finally I've deleted the [i]L'animateur[/i] achievement, it just is counter-intuitive.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36542669/0397c5d666dbd5064ecc50e19bb7e4a67de334e1.png[/img]

[i]The picture in this change log is by [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/art/view/lintire/deity-driving-yes]Lintire[/url]. [/i]

That's it and [b]thank you[/b] for the attention!

PS:
The Deity wants you to stop calling him Yoda, that's very rude!

notes.title: First update for Deity Driving!
notes.notes:
Hi there,
a playthrough by Soshiki Hakase helped me find some more bugs that I didn't see before!

[previewyoutube=9afHihevPic;full]][/previewyoutube]

Now fixed:[list][*] Not being enter to able the garage under certain circumstances
[*] The driving school music not playing
[*] Fixed being able to use god hand in driving school too early
[*] Updated the credits sequence
[*] The Squatter achievement is now easier to get, driving school isn't mandatory at all!
[*] Fixed being able to spam Duckman's 2nd rap several times[/list]
Thanks for everyone who has played it or spread the word!

Have a nice Sunday,

Vinzenz
